title: Decide: authority DID, action/resource mapping, tier policy
description: Owner decision (bd human). Needs: the authority_id (e.g. did:web on kernel.org) and who hosts its DID document; which TRQP actions map to which minimum git-vouch tier (e.g. git.commit.sign -> contributor, tag signing -> maintainer); whether resource is ignored (registry-wide tiers, the git-vouch model) or scoped per repository (git-vouch has no per-repo scope today); staleness policy (refuse authorized=true when the registry copy is older than N days?).
acceptance_criteria: Decisions recorded in DESIGN.md (new 'TRQP bridge' section) and bead closed with the choices.
